verdicts.reasoning: All seeds require the student to break down a number into its structural components (either numerically as an addition of tens and ones, or visually using base-10 blocks), which is the definition of decomposition.
Every seed consistently utilizes a 2-digit number (e.g., 10, 20, 45, 50) as the primary subject of the prompt.
The questions explicitly ask the student to write the number as 'tens and ones', or prompt for the use of 'base-10 blocks' which are physical representations of tens and ones.
